[h3][b]Age of Chaos[/b][/h3]
Age of Chaos is a new way to play Age of History.
Every 20 years, you will have to change the Civilization you control and switch to a new one.

You will be given four random Civilization to choose from.
Pick one and continue your journey, even if it means one day fighting the empire you once ruled.

You can also change the time period when the Age of Chaos (Change of Civilization) happens.

[b]Have fun![/b]

Presentation of the new game mode, Age of Chaos, and how it works in Age of History 2: Definitive Edition.
In Age of History 3, it works the same as shown in the video.
[previewyoutube=aGOzBgfDhos;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Update:[/b][/h3]
Fixed a random bug where time would stop in the game and the game would no longer run while playing in Age of Chaos mode.

A_Mods_steam_workshop_READ_ME.txt
[code]#############################
## Steam Workshop
##
## When reading any file, the game will prioritize files in the 'mods/' folder first, followed by
## subscribed items from the Steam Workshop, and finally the default game files.
## 
## You can find all files for this example in the 'modsExample/' folder within the game files.
##
#####

To create a new mod that can be submitted to the Steam Workshop, create a new folder for your mod in the 'mods/' directory.

Inside this folder, organize your files in the same structure as they are found in the game's directories.

Example:

# Step 1

Create a new folder within the 'mods/' directory in the game files.
For this example, we'll name the folder 'MyOwnMod'.
Make sure the folder name is unique!

# Step 2

In the newly created folder (example path: mods/MyOwnMod/), create a text file named mod.txt.

## EXAMPLE CODE OF mod.txt file

{
	Name: "Two new Governments",
	Description: "This item will add two new Governments, and two flags.",
	
	Tags: [ "Map", "Government" ],
	
	ChangeNote: "First release",
}

## END OF EXAMPLE CODE OF mod.txt file

Copy it to mod.txt and edit it.

Set a name for your mod that will be visible in the Steam Workshop.

Name: "Your Title of the Mod in the Steam Workshop",

The same with Description and ChangeNote.


## Tags
In your tags, put the categories that your mod fits into


You can use as many tags as you like:
Tags: [ "FIRST_TAG", "SECOND_TAG", "THIRD_TAG" ],
Tags: [ "FIRST_TAG" ],

Example tags:

Tags: [ "Map", "Government" ],
Tags: [ "Scenario" ],
Tags: [ "Mod", "Laws", "Units", "Buildings" ],

# Step 3 - Main mod image: "logo.png"

In the same newly created folder: (Example path: mods/MyOwnMod/)

Place the main image file of the mod, which will be published on the Steam Workshop.

The mod's main image file must be named "logo.png".


# Step 4

We are already configured, now we can place the files that will be part of this mod in this folder.
We will create new governments for the game in this example.

## Basically, you create the file structure of the main game in the mod folder.


The Governments file is located in the path:
Game/Governments.json


So copy this file to the mod folder. Imporatant! : use the same path where you found this file.

mods/MyOwnMod/game/
## The file was in the game folder, so create a game folder inside the mod folder and place the copied file there.

If the "game" folder does not exist in the mod folder, create it. And there place Governments.json

Now when you launch the game, the game will load the Governments.json file from your mod. (Path of the file: mods/MyOwnMod/game/Governments.json)


# Step 5

Let's make some changes to the game!

Open Governments.json as a text file in Notepad.


### EXAMPLE CODE

		{
			Name: "YourGovernmentType",
			Extra_Tag: "k",
			GOV_GROUP_ID: 0,
			
			RulerTitle: King,
			RulerRoman: true,
			KingsImages: true,
			
			Color: [255, 194, 36],
			
			AVAILABLE_SINCE_AGE_ID: 0,
			
			REVOLUTIONISTS: false,
			
			AdvisorCost: -0.05,
			MonthlyLegacy: 0.35,
			MaxManpower: 1000,
		},
		
### EXAMPLE CODE END

You can add new Goverment from example code after any:
"		},"
in the file.


Add new Goveremnt to the file.
Extra_Tag: "k", (The tag should be unique)


To publish your mod to Steam Workshop, open the game, go to editor -> Steam Workshop -> and find your mod folder, click on it to publish.


## Update the mod

To update the mod, follow the same steps.
You can change "ChangeNote" description in mod.txt.

Do not delete the automatically created id.txt file![/code]

notes.title: Unveiling the Battlefield
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders! Today, we delve into the fiery heart of war – the battlefield! Here, meticulously crafted strategies clash in a dynamic struggle for dominance. Let's explore the intricate dance of military might that unfolds in our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/eda268ca92d49630db4bece397f0be4bdc4c9060.png[/img]

[h3]The Art of Deployment[/h3]
Every battle begins with the deployment phase. Two opposing armies, one attacking and the other defending, face off on a meticulously detailed battlefield. Each army is strategically organized into two lines:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/065f5983a4897d905cd7ee7b73466f6de517b216.png[/img]

[h3]Front Line[/h3]
This vanguard bears the brunt of the enemy assault. Units here need to be resilient, well-disciplined, and capable of delivering devastating blows.

[h3]Second Line[/h3]
This support line provides crucial backup. They may offer ranged attacks, bolster the morale of frontline troops, or fulfill specialized functions.


The maximum number of regiments you can deploy depends on the [b]battle width[/b]. This, in turn, is determined by the greater battle width of the civilizations involved. A larger battle width allows for grander clashes with more troops, while a smaller width necessitates a more focused deployment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/8759b55e75d4ba8c26b03d9f9e3e976fca308440.png[/img]

[h3]Generals play a pivotal role in battle.[/h3]
Their leadership inspires troops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/d8433bbd81b63cb34b75558547777114b8950c53.png[/img]

[b]Attack Value[/b]: A high attack value increases enemy casualties, significantly impacting their fighting ability. This value is determined in part by a dice roll mechanic, adding an element of uncertainty to even the most meticulously planned battles.
[b]Defense Value[/b]: A strong defense value bolsters your troops' resilience, minimizing your own losses. This, combined with the attack value, underlines the crucial strategic importance of a skilled general.

[h3]The Thrill of Combat[/h3]
The battle phase unfolds over a predetermined number of days, each one a whirlwind of activity

[b]Frontline Clashes[/b]: Units in the front line engage in brutal combat, inflicting casualties on their enemy counterparts.
[b]Second Line Support[/b]: Units in the second line can also participate, unleashing attacks on the enemy's front line if within range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/7f5b8b3bf3b3db3522dbbd6dc213b15a1e5b15f1.png[/img]

These clashes result in casualties, forcing units to retreat or fight with diminished effectiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/7650dfeae923f49ab9a71319ec12facb457099ed.png[/img]

[h3]The Shifting Sands of Morale[/h3]
Morale plays a critical role in battlefield dynamics.
As casualties mount and units suffer losses, their morale can plummet.

[h3]Low morale can lead to[/h3]
[b]Retreat[/b]: Units may choose to retreat from the battlefield, removing their strength from the fight and potentially disrupting the entire formation.
[b]Reduced Effectiveness[/b]: Units with low morale fight less effectively, impacting your overall fighting potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f9a08ee82dd045082297418e5e4f7a50305f283b.png[/img]

[h3]The Terrain Advantage[/h3]
The type of terrain you fight on can significantly impact the battlefield. Rugged mountains can offer defensive bonuses to your front line, while open plains leave them exposed but allow for flanking maneuvers. Understanding the terrain and using it to your advantage is key to achieving tactical superiority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/e45576ebf23fe45b98e497a18770f58ede0a8582.png[/img]

[h3]Battles conclude with one of two outcomes[/h3]
Destruction: An army is considered destroyed if it cannot sustain itself for the entire battle duration. This can occur due to overwhelming casualties, plummeting morale, or a strategic retreat.
Survival: If an army survives the battle phase with sufficient troops and morale, it emerges victorious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/2130f4f71cd573e78f10a60b43621cc1b1184694.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a023e2805da45fbff2b59e5a3bd2b1e619a3802e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/e00031f30e97bd88c94f891727e07af4ed2875c2.png[/img]

notes.title: Unveiling Sieges
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders! Today, we set our sights on the fortified walls that shield your enemies – sieges! These critical undertakings test your military might and strategic cunning as you strive to breach enemy defenses and claim victory.

[h3]The Art of the Siege[/h3]
Your army surrounds the enemy province, initiating a siege. Each day, the combined Siege Ability of all your participating units contributes to the siege progress.
The siege progress is pitted against the province's Defense level. The higher the province's defense, the longer it takes to wear down its fortifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/93fc06d284f094c346e4028d3a3e521647dbf06d.png[/img]

Siege units play a crucial role in overcoming enemy defenses. Their Siege Ability directly translates into siege progress, hastening the day you breach the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/50749b7ba90e6fb59eb37bfa3f5ef12899787446.png[/img]

[h3]A successful siege brings glorious rewards[/h3]
You gain control of the besieged province, allowing you to exploit its resources and strengthen your own nation. 
This is where things get truly strategic. Neighboring provinces without defensive structures, like forts, fall under your control as well. This reflects the chaos and vulnerability that often follow a successful siege, creating a domino effect that can rapidly expand your domain.
The province will also be plundered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/771a4f3025e00ffdd44d15f0f34885499d0fbb68.png[/img]


[h3]The Importance of Fortifications[/h3]
This system underscores the vital role of fortifications in defensive strategies. Investing in forts for your own provinces not only bolsters their individual defense but also creates a defensive network that discourages enemy incursions and protects neighboring settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/82cd649b8451b01b07c9e9124b8fd362cca0ddb3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/905f629a983148f016cb5df15e5112e60526c74f.png[/img]

[h3]Siege Unit Composition[/h3]
The right mix of siege units can significantly accelerate your progress. Experiment with different combinations to find the optimal force for the situation.

[h3]A Strategic Weapon[/h3]
Sieges are more than just brute force assaults. They are strategic tools that can tip the scales of war in your favor. By understanding the mechanics and leveraging them effectively, you can carve a path to glorious conquest.

notes.title: The Weight of History - Civilization Legacies
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today, we explore a cornerstone of your civilization's enduring legacy: Legacy Points and Civilization Legacies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/bd05d053e1af86fda802916de0f24a8bbdabc0be.png[/img]

[b]The Marks of Progress:[/b]
Legacy Points represent the accumulated achievements and milestones of your civilization. These points are earned through various means.

[b]Building a Lasting Legacy:[/b]
Legacy Points are used to unlock Civilization Legacies, permanent bonuses that solidify your civilization's strengths and shape its future. These legacies encompass diverse areas, granting you advantages in administration, economics, military prowess, and diplomacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/d0250eaab6cc04b3fa00c27ba084e106ea79024c.png[/img]

[b]Investing in Your Empire:[/b]
Legacy Points have a broader application beyond unlocking legacies. They are also a vital resource for several critical actions within your empire. These include:

Recruiting Skilled Personnel: Hire talented generals and advisors to enhance your military leadership and governance.
Optimizing Your Provinces: Invest Legacy Points to increase tax efficiency and manpower in your provinces, bolstering your economic and military might.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/d0e37dff7510f462b93ca0da69778ac2a341a882.png[/img]

[b]Maximizing your Legacy Point gain is crucial. You can achieve this by:[/b]
Appointing Wise Advisors: Certain advisors specialize in boosting legacy point generation, providing long-term benefits to your civilization.
Monumental Construction: Construct specific buildings within your provinces that contribute to your legacy point income, further enriching your nation's legacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/266c1e90ed71e22a73865f8312214662056cb1cc.png[/img]


[h3]Civilization Legacies are categorized into four distinct groups:[/h3]
[b]Administrative Legacies[/b]: Enhance your governance, bolstering your internal stability and efficiency.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/37f9e658a36701638cb5cd313fdd557c993d5e03.png[/img]

[b]Economic Legacies[/b]: Strengthen your economic backbone, generating greater wealth and resourcefulness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a3a396d0837303a646348990b17e3e6aaaf42879.png[/img]

[b]Military Legacies[/b]: Fortify your military might, granting advantages in troop recruitment, training, and battlefield tactics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/d9be2b268da96dbf413d48b0926ac293805d01e1.png[/img]

[b]Diplomatic Legacies[/b]: Sharpen your diplomatic edge, improving your foreign relations and influence on the world stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/49acf470a827df8b2b417c3919c79413e44270a3.png[/img]


[b]The Path to Greatness:[/b]
By wisely investing Legacy Points into these diverse benefits, you can forge a legacy that defines your civilization for generations to come.  Choosing the right legacies will be crucial in shaping your nation's destiny and ensuring its dominance in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/0f3fac85811a17204b108ef56e9b2ca9d6306650.png[/img]

notes.title: Technology and Civilization Advantages
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/ee769970758fa438205caa7ac145fb17d5d76e98.png[/img]

[h2]A Roadmap to Innovation:[/h2]

Wise Advisors: Appoint an Innovation Advisor, their expertise speeding up your research efforts and shortening the time it takes to unlock new technologies.

Carefully spend them to acquire Civilization Advantages.  These powerful perks will be crucial in shaping your nation's destiny.

notes.title: The Power of Laws
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today, we delve into a cornerstone of civilization: the law system.

[h3]The Evolving Legal Landscape[/h3]
Each civilization possesses a unique legal framework, and as your nation progresses through the tech tree, you'll unlock a variety of innovative laws.  These laws offer diverse benefits and represent the evolving legal landscape of your civilization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/721b3522c819fc067ef0474c72408ed8d7f6c100.png[/img]

[h3]Let's explore some examples[/h3]

[h3]Monetary Policy[/h3]
This law set impacts your nation's economic system. As you progress, you can enact laws like:

Commodity Money: This basic system utilizes physical goods like grains or metals as currency.
Minted Coins: This introduces standardized coins, increasing stability and efficiency in trade.
Paper Currency: This allows for the adoption of paper money for transactions, further boosting economic flexibility.
Central Banking System: Establishing a central bank regulates currency and promotes economic growth.
Digital Currency: This law represents the cutting edge, implementing digital currencies and modern financial technologies.

Each law within this set will offer specific bonuses,  such as increased income from production, improved production efficiency, or a higher maximum amount of gold you can hold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/b9047ac609136add46cbcea94bfd57775ebe1a98.png[/img]

[h3]Conscription Laws[/h3]
This law set governs how you build your military.  

Feudal Levies: This system relies on nobles providing troops to the monarch as part of their feudal duty.
Draft System: This enacts mandatory military service for all able-bodied citizens for a set period.
Selective Service: This allows the government to select individuals for service based on specific criteria.
Professional Volunteer Army: This system relies on voluntary enlistment to build your military force.
Professional Standing Army: Here, your military is comprised of well-trained, full-time professional soldiers.

These laws will impact various aspects of your military, such as increasing your maximum manpower pool, changing the time it takes to recruit units, boosting unit discipline, or raising the maximum level of your Military Academy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/5deb4db8a1afb179bbd5fda9f6ddf858dbe2f71f.png[/img]

[b]Laws and Legacy[/b]
Remember, each law offers unique bonuses that complement your civilization's overall strategy.  Choose your laws wisely, as they will shape your society and define its path to greatness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/c92d72c1eb7373fd89e0a827165733e36349c363.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Battle Tactics
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders! Today, I'm thrilled to unveil a feature inspired by the brilliant minds of our community – Battle Tactics! This exciting addition injects a layer of strategic depth into your military campaigns, allowing you to outmaneuver your foes and claim glorious victories.

[h3]Harnessing the Power of Maneuver[/h3]
Battle Tactics are specialized maneuvers employed by your armies on the battlefield. Each tactic offers unique advantages and drawbacks, empowering you to tailor your approach based on the situation. From weathering enemy assaults to flanking their formations, Battle Tactics give you the tools to exploit enemy weaknesses and seize the upper hand.

[h3]Let's delve into the four core Battle Tactics available[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a7ac3045fd846aa125203b6578af92034df85f29.png[/img]

[h3]Careful Advance[/h3]
Units Attack: +0
Units Defense: +0
This tactic prioritizes minimizing casualties while maintaining pressure. Units advance cautiously, maintaining their standard attack power while receiving a defensive bonus. It's ideal for closing the distance on a weakened enemy or weathering a heavy enemy assault.

[h3]Defensive Hold[/h3]
Units Attack: -2
Units Defense: +3
This tactic transforms your army into an unyielding wall. Units take a penalty to their attack power but gain a significant defensive boost. This tactic is perfect for fortifying a position, protecting key objectives, or blunting the momentum of a charging enemy force.

[h3]Straight Charge[/h3]
Units Attack: +3
Units Defense: -2
This tactic emphasizes offensive power. Units unleash a devastating charge, sacrificing some defense for a significant increase in attack power.

[h3]Flanking Maneuver[/h3]
Units Attack: +2
Units Defense: -1
This tactic seeks to outmaneuver the enemy. Units prioritize flanking the enemy formation, gaining a bonus to attack power while taking a moderate defensive penalty.

[h3]A Fan-Fueled Feature[/h3]
This system wouldn't exist without the ingenuity of our dedicated community. A keen-eyed forum member proposed the concept of Battle Tactics, igniting a passionate discussion about potential tactics and their impact on warfare.

[h3]The Art of Command[/h3]
The most effective tactic depends on several factors, including the terrain, the composition of your and your enemy's armies, and the overall battlefield situation. A true leader assesses the battlefield and chooses the tactic that best exploits enemy vulnerabilities and leverages your own forces' strengths. Mastering Battle Tactics takes practice and a keen understanding of the battlefield dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/655cd3d19caed46d347930927f8cd13230bf8ab6.png[/img]

notes.title: Special Civilization Upgrades
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today, we focus on the vital cornerstones of any great civilization: the civilization upgrades found within the government view. These permanent improvements empower your civilization, providing lasting benefits that set it on a path to dominance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/7016c92fd2dd62f3015db1b14a1612e46fbd1394.png[/img]

[h3]The Ever-Expanding Capital[/h3]
Every civilization boasts a capital city, the heart that pumps lifeblood through your civilization. By investing gold, you can elevate your capital's level, reaping significant rewards:

Booming Economy: Each level increase generates a higher monthly income, bolstering your financial resources and allowing you to pursue ambitious goals.
Streamlined Administration: Upkeep costs for all your provinces decrease with each level upgrade, freeing up resources for other crucial investments.
The maximum level your capital can reach can be further expanded through various means:

Unlocking Civilization Legacies: Certain legacies offer permanent increases to your capital's potential for growth.
Researching Key Technologies: Breakthroughs in specific technological fields can unlock higher capital levels.
Claiming Civilization Advantages: Wisely chosen advantages can permanently expand the potential of your capital city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/30405dd57db217325d2c0a3418b4ef3d9418243b.png[/img]

[h3]Combating the Shadow of Corruption[/h3]
Corruption is a persistent threat, siphoning away potential income from your provinces. Here, the Supreme Court steps in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/c83422d618fc23876aaeaafe2f2ff84b435cca9e.png[/img]
Each upgrade level diminishes corruption's grip, allowing you to retain a greater share of your hard-earned income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/25989e97895a4dc79c52d6788285ef16a6433a6b.png[/img]

[h3]Forging Elite Forces[/h3]
The Military Academy plays a crucial role in honing the combat prowess of your troops. Each upgrade level brings the following benefits:

Enhanced Units: All your units gain improved attack and defense values, making them more lethal on the battlefield and ensuring victory against even the most formidable foes.
Expanded Regiments: The limit on the number of regiments you can field increases, allowing you to build a larger and more formidable army, capable of overwhelming any enemy.

Similar to your capital city, the Military Academy's maximum level can be further increased through:

Civilization Legacies: Specific legacies unlock higher potential levels for your Military Academy.
Technological Advancements: Researching certain technologies can expand the maximum level of your Military Academy.
Civilization Advantages: Strategic use of advantages can permanently raise the level cap for your Military Academy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a3665d69fe57bd7c90ed5f72781468b8410c0053.png[/img]

[h3]Empowering Your Leaders[/h3]
The Military Academy for Generals offers a more specialized approach to military advancement. Upgrading this building provides the following:

Elite Leadership: All your generals benefit from improved leadership skills, enhancing the overall effectiveness of your armies through superior tactics and strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/269a0599486881348599f78ad2a9c7f67675a624.png[/img]

[h3]Shaping Your Legacy:[/h3]
These special Civilization upgrades provide crucial options for building your civilization. Choose wisely, tailoring your investments to your strategic goals. Invest in your capital to strengthen your economic foundation, combat corruption to bolster your income, or elevate your military academies to forge an unstoppable army. Remember, a powerful and enduring nation is built upon a foundation of strategic foresight and wise resource allocation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/0e7bd24e9c9bb933aeaff666221be4b28db2948f.png[/img]

notes.title: The Power of Government
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today, we delve into the very core of your Civilization: its form of government. The chosen system will not only define who holds power, but also shape your Civilization's character and its path to dominance.

[h3]A Spectrum of Leadership[/h3]
Age of History 3 offers a diverse range of government types, each with its own unique set of strengths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/d14ac6bb4a5085a16ad534bffb86ff19d191d6e8.png[/img]

Let's explore some key examples:

[h3]Monarchy[/h3]
This traditional system vests leadership in a single ruler. Benefits include:

Advisor Expertise: You can secure the services of advisors at a 10% discount, allowing you to access their valuable expertise without breaking the bank.
Legacy of Leadership: Monarchs generate a monthly Legacy point bonus, accelerating your progress towards unlocking powerful civilization legacies.
Strong Military Foundation: Monarchy bolsters your Civilization's manpower pool by an additional 2,000, allowing you to build a larger and more formidable army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/cca4cb5f1770f3781da64a6aac92d6219c305c84.png[/img]

[h3]Merchant Republic[/h3]
This system prioritizes commerce and trade. Its benefits include:

Economic Efficiency: Production output across all your provinces increases by 4%, significantly boosting your income-generating potential.
Frugal Construction: The cost of constructing economic buildings decreases by 5%, allowing you to expand your economic infrastructure more efficiently.
Swift Recruitment: Recruitment times for new units are reduced by 10%, ensuring you can field your forces quickly in times of need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a59d098ba0c5f4c2d594cff9b8dd7ddb6b10b715.png[/img]

[h3]City-State[/h3]
This system focuses on the development of a central urban hub. Its benefits include:

Efficient Administration: Province maintenance costs are reduced by 10%, freeing up resources for other crucial investments.
Resilient Defenses: All units stationed within your territory gain a bonus of 3 defense points, making them more resistant to enemy attacks.
Urban Expansion: Your provinces gain 4 additional building slots, allowing you to construct a wider range of structures and further develop your cities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f7813c30e14c025cf48b3238b6ac57333db43bf0.png[/img]

[h3]The Price of Change[/h3]
Changing type of government requires an investment of gold and Legacy points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/79049338da7ed337c3959a7731eeab9d3c37df16.png[/img]

[h3]Unlocking New Horizons[/h3]
Certain government types become available through research in the technology tree. As your civilization advances, you'll unlock the potential to create political structures that align with your evolving needs and ambitions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f290e52899dd1842b342389b195bffaf67f11f5f.png[/img]

notes.title: Navigating Your Budget
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today, we delve into the lifeblood of any Civilization: the budget view. Here, you'll wield the tools to manage your income, expenses, and ultimately, the fate of your Civilization.

[h3]The Heart of Financial Control[/h3]
The budget view provides a clear picture of your civilization's financial health. It displays your income, expenses, and current balance, allowing you to make informed decisions regarding resource allocation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/c8a8180a8f62709dcaff279b78acb3e0ce21efbe.png[/img]

[h3]Taxing Your People[/h3]
Taxation is a vital source of income, but striking the right balance is crucial. You can adjust tax levels in three tiers:

Low Taxation: This reduces unrest and fosters research, but generates minimal income.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f855422d3e6e68a68b20b1388891e7185bd8db87.png[/img]

Default Taxation: The standard setting, balancing income generation.
Severe Taxation: This approach significantly boosts your coffers, but at the cost of higher unrest, decreasing research and Legacy Point generation.
Choose wisely! A happy populace is a productive one, while an overly-taxed society could rebel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a0aab93aa8b51c8dc2d63ff139c16a28527941c6.png[/img]

[h3]The Cost of War[/h3]
Maintaining a strong military is vital, but comes with a price. You can adjust army maintenance spending in three ways:

Decreased Pay: This lowers costs but negatively impacts troop morale, leadin decreased effectiveness in battle.
Default Spending: This maintains a healthy balance between cost and morale.
Increased Pay: This boosts morale and improves troop performance, but significantly increases your financial burden.
A well-funded army is a powerful tool, but ensure you can afford to maintain its edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/ba39f673d6ca7b176fb237e0e505ce5e1408e982.png[/img]

[h3]Fueling Innovation[/h3]
Research is the key to advancement, and the budget view allows you to control your research spending:

Decreased Funding: This cuts costs but significantly slows research progress.
Default Funding: This maintains a steady pace of research.
Increased Funding: This significantly boosts research speed, but demands a hefty financial commitment.
Invest wisely in research to unlock new technologies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/4e127bc3c7c56517febd2e9a397d268ccabdfa85.png[/img]

[h3]Borrowing with Caution[/h3]
In times of need, the budget view allows you to take out loans. However, remember – loans are not free money! They come with interest and a limited number can be taken. Use them strategically only during emergencies or to seize critical opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/4df8292ff9eea40138684675c454be1a33f7a525.png[/img]

[h3]Prosperity at a Glance[/h3]

The budget view also introduces the Prosperity Tier. This metric reflects the average economic health of your provinces, taking into account population and development. A higher Prosperity Tier translates to a stronger national economy, generating more income from your various sources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f4dd1b09924cf533831574daef1905a2b97a2a9a.png[/img]

[h3]The Art of Management[/h3]

Mastering your budget is a vital skill. By carefully balancing income, expenses, and strategic investments, you can ensure your Civilization's prosperity and pave the way for its dominance.

Until then, remember – a wise leader knows that true power lies not on the battlefield alone, but in the ability to manage a thriving and stable economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/e14a2003e15f1f05543901486d72d78f07a98a78.png[/img]

notes.title: The Heart of Your Civilization - Province
notes.content:
[h1]The Heart of Your Civilization - Province[/h1]
Greetings, leaders! Today's development diary delves into the beating heart of your Civilization: your provinces. These diverse regions hold the key to your Civilization's prosperity and military might. Let's explore the intricate details that define each province and the tools at your disposal to optimize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/265ead7ef1c3ec7be3d29521ee0dfcc4e8578c2e.png[/img]

[h3]Lay of the Land[/h3]
The terrain of your provinces plays a crucial role. From fertile plains offering bountiful harvests to rugged mountains fostering hardy warriors, each type offers unique bonuses. Understanding your terrain is key to maximizing your province's potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/8e635ea0bead41b3092a7d5d0df7ca26fc994a32.png[/img]

[h3]Claiming Your Rightful Land[/h3]
Conquered territories require a core, a symbol of your civilization's legitimate claim. Uncored provinces suffer an income penalty, highlighting the importance of integrating them into your empire.

[h3]A Flourishing Population[/h3]
The people residing within your provinces are your most valuable asset. Each province has a population and a diverse mix of nationalities. As your core solidifies, assimilation will occur, creating a more unified populace.

[h3]Taxing for the Common Good[/h3]
Provinces generate income from taxation. A higher tax efficiency translates to a richer treasury. Wisely invest gold and civilization legacy points, or construct specific buildings, to optimize tax collection. Remember, a thriving population provides the best returns, so prioritize provinces with high growth potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/3e31bf1742c031189c8a962e089c74889d01ce0d.png[/img]

[h3]Growing Your Population[/h3]
Population is a crucial factor in your overall strength. Each province has a growth rate, determining its natural population increase. Wise investment in gold or specific buildings like farms and granaries will boost this growth, ensuring a steady stream of manpower and potential taxpayers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/350e35d864201e0a1b6520ec9fed7011f0967f33.png[/img]

[h3]Economic Engines[/h3]
Provinces not only generate income from taxes, but also from their economies and any resource they possess. However, a province's maximum economic output is linked to its population growth rate, capped at half its value. Invest in workshops and other economic buildings to stimulate growth and maximize your income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/809e083d2bc514e2f59465bfa8f7133d1a773eb2.png[/img]

[h3]Faith and Fortune[/h3]
Religion plays a significant role. If a province's dominant religion differs from your civilization's, income suffers. Sending missionaries can convert the population, forging religious unity and boosting your income potential.

[h3]Manpower: The Backbone of Your Army[/h3]
Each province contributes to your overall manpower pool, the lifeblood of your military. Growth rate and local manpower levels determine the number of potential recruits a province can provide. Manage your manpower strategically, ensuring a steady stream of soldiers to defend your realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/ed2edd66ef49f12d3082d2b1f69e0fd1a62f2ac5.png[/img]

[h3]Building a Strong Foundation[/h3]
Infrastructure development brings a range of benefits to your provinces. Invest gold and civilization legacy points to enhance their capabilities.

[h3]Unearthing Riches[/h3]
Certain provinces may hold unique resources, further fueling your economy and potentially offering strategic advantages. Research new technologies to unlock the ability to construct resource-specific buildings and maximize your output.

[h3]Growth and Development[/h3]
As your economy expands, the potential for new buildings within a province increases. Research unlocks new structures, allowing you to further specialize and optimize your provinces.

[h3]The Scars of War[/h3]
Military actions and disease can devastate a province, reducing its income potential. 

The province view provides valuable insights. Here you can assess the potential loot you can acquire after a successful siege, helping you plan your military campaigns strategically.

By understanding and managing these intricate details, you can transform your provinces from mere territories into thriving centers of wealth and power. The fate of your empire rests on your ability to cultivate and optimize these vital building blocks of your realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/fba9ea37689d892278fc80f4fc9b95a7c24d17a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Resources and Production
notes.content:
Greetings, leaders! Today's development diary delves into the foundation of any thriving Civilization: its resources. In Age of History 3, you'll have a diverse selection of 49 unique resources at your disposal, ranging from the staples of life like grain and rice to the luxuries of porcelain and glass.

[h3]A World of Potential[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/e3f36162f9ba356b83b69ba04c06e25de726bf85.png[/img]

Each province within your realm holds the potential to produce a single, unique resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/a9a26e44a8189ad121fa03c51cb2b194f48b02a3.png[/img]

This resource will be the lifeblood of your economy, providing a steady stream of income based on two key factors:

[b]Base Price Value[/b]: This inherent worth of the resource sets the baseline for its potential income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/f1d44973cfd13ecb05117b8f2833af987a22935b.png[/img]

[h3]Production Efficiency[/h3]
This variable represents the effectiveness of a province in extracting or cultivating its designated resource. Higher efficiency translates to greater income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/c359c712437c084a963e5023d02300ecf436d203.png[/img]

[h3]Investing in Your Land[/h3]
The good news? You don't have to settle for the status quo. Investing in a province's economy allows you to boost its production efficiency, maximizing your resource output. Think of it as nurturing the land and optimizing its productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/86e04bc7c957a157c9cefae321659b07b866b774.png[/img]

[h3]Unlocking Specialized Potential[/h3]
Technology is not just about shiny new weapons or advancements in warfare. Research unlocks unique buildings specific to each resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/8aeee8a81f7dba95dab8ca1dc0964167a8a40923.png[/img]

For instance, wool production flourishes with a dedicated sheep farm, while grain benefits from a well-maintained grain farm. Cattle ranchers and iron mines further enhance resource extraction in their respective provinces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/18d255937da0b7b1b4378e4c9c339bd1a2722e0b.png[/img]

[h3]The Power of Plenty[/h3]
Domination isn't just about military might. Becoming the leading producer of a specific resource grants your Civilization a powerful, unique bonus. This can significantly enhance your economic, military, or diplomatic standing. The race to become a resource titan is an ongoing one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/bbb30c50dd577b14e3f17184ed66137c80a7a7bd.png[/img]

Remember, a Civilization's true strength lies in its ability to harness the potential of its land and its people.

notes.title: Shaping Your Legacy - The Council and Advisors
notes.content:
Greetings, rulers! Today's dev diary sheds light on two crucial pillars of your Civilization's success: The Council and your esteemed Advisors.

[h3]The Guiding Hand:[/h3]
The Council serves as your inner circle, a group of trusted individuals offering counsel and shaping your Civilization's trajectory. 
Led by the Ruler (King in monarchies, elected official in republics), the Council's composition reflects your government type. Ruler receives up to four random, small bonuses that can bolster your leadership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/31e4e95eb38c6222d41d72e64b018205020fab44.png[/img]

[h3]Specialized Expertise[/h3]
Beyond the Council's general wisdom, you can bolster your Civilization's strength by hiring specialized Advisors. Each advisor represents a critical domain:

[h3]Administrative Advisor[/h3]
This seasoned bureaucrat offers bonuses to streamline your realm's operation. Expect reductions in province maintenance costs, administrative building construction, construction time, and even religious conversion costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/3f074b19158667547aed4ef2fb86695485f69ea1.png[/img]

[h3]Economic Advisor[/h3]
With a keen eye for profit, this advisor unlocks benefits for your economic engine. You'll see lower costs for province investment and economic buildings, increased production efficiency, plus a reduction in core creation costs and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/013b49f1151bb33933a3bac849384692d28b625a.png[/img]

[h3]Innovation Advisor[/h3]
This visionary thinker expedites your technological advancement. They might accelerate research or cement your civilization's legacy with unique bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/722eeeaf9ea0971e7eb6f1724fab2059a0272c3b.png[/img]

[h3]Military Advisor[/h3]
A seasoned strategist, this advisor provides tactical advantages to your armed forces. Expect bonuses for your generals (attack/defense), reduced army maintenance costs, higher siege effectiveness, or even an increase in your Civilization 's overall manpower and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/c9713d11640e6d792cd9511d44b8f1a05d29f57f.png[/img]


[h3]Investing in Greatness[/h3]
Hiring advisors requires both gold and civilization legacy. These permanent acquisitions become invaluable assets, shaping your Civilization 's path.

[h3]Sharpening the Edge[/h3]
But the story doesn't end there. As your civilization unlocks new legacies or technologies, you can further enhance your advisors' skills. By increasing their skill level, all existing bonuses receive a +50% boost.

[h3]A Symphony of Expertise[/h3]
The Council and Advisors work in tandem. The Council provides a foundation of leadership, while advisors offer specialized expertise to truly propel your Civilization to greatness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831059/e828396f42348de3169d72b5b3932672870ae030.png[/img]

I eagerly await your feedback! Let me know your thoughts on the Council and Advisors, and how they might shape your strategies in the game.
